We know that a questionnaire can’t pick up on everything, like treatable underlying health issues that can cause hearing loss. If you still have concerns about your hearing, we recommend that you contact your local GP or Ear Nose and Throat Doctor to check the health of your ears.

macros.title: Email Templates::Samaritans Email
macros.description: An email to send to customers who have expressed that they're struggling mentally.

actions.value:
{{dc.standard-salutation}}


Thank you for reaching out. I appreciate that reaching out can be really difficult.


Sometimes it's easier to speak to people you don't know as there's no pressure. The Samaritans are available to call 24 hours a day, 365 days of the year and they're always available to listen and help - 116 123


I find that writing down feelings can also help understand them better. If you think that this is better for you, you can also email them through their website.

https://www.samaritans.org/how-we-can-help/contact-samaritan/write-email/


I am in no way trained in giving advice for such situations, though I want you to know that there's help out there and you're not alone in your feelings.


Please take care of yourself.


All the best,

{{dc.standard-boots_agent_signature_simple}}
